scope: Governance RAR/UIREF parser helper/validator review-churn prevention across PR #276 and PR #278
purpose: Prevent another Codex Connector comment loop by proving source-truth, implementation, fixture, generated sibling-mutation coverage, and high-churn root-cause receipt proof before requesting another PR review.

root_cause_receipts.root_cause: PR Readiness Stage 1 and the same-PR repair loop treated resolved connector comments plus family coverage as sufficient even though the live PR had already accumulated high-volume same-family parser churn.
root_cause_receipts.prevention_summary: High connector-comment volume now exceeds a churn budget and cannot pass the local review-churn helper unless a current PR root-cause receipt records exact live counts, family counts, source-truth cause, and preventive source-truth/helper/fixture repairs.
preventive_changes: Docs/phase_governance.md defines high-volume PR review churn as a PR Readiness Stage 1 prediction failure.
Docs/validation_helper_registry.md makes the review-churn helper enforce comment budgets and exact PR root-cause receipts.
Docs/incident_patterns.md records the PR #278 49-comment loop as budget-exceeded review churn.
dev/orin_pr_review_churn_validation.py fails over-budget PRs without exact root-cause receipt proof.

root_cause_receipts.root_cause: PR #287 external-state drift repair correctly moved active RRI, PR, and release-window facts out of repo docs, but PR2 treated each Codex Connector comment as an isolated parser fix instead of recognizing a repeated standing-governance live-state boundary family.
root_cause_receipts.prevention_summary: The PR2 churn classifier now recognizes release target, external RRI state, return-digest closeout, worktree-confinement, transition-legal active-record, and suffixed Active RRI Cycle comments as repo-live-state-boundary-parser coverage, and the root-cause receipt records exact PR #287 live review counts before another review request.
preventive_changes: dev/orin_pr_review_churn_validation.py classifies PR #287 standing-governance external-state/RRI review comments instead of leaving them unknown.
dev/orin_branch_governance_validation.py rejects in-repo Active RRI Cycle values that start with RRI-YYYYMMDD-NNN even when suffix text follows.
dev/orin_repo_live_state_leakage_scan.py uses the same start-of-RRI blocker for strict active-RRI leakage scanning.
Docs/branch_records/feature_release_readiness_source_truth_intake.md records the PR #287 review-churn root-cause receipt.
